selected_evidence.requirement: Restore config.json from the latest backup
selected_evidence.summary: Only one backup existed; it passed integrity and JSON validation. The restored config SHA-256 exactly matched its archived copy.
current.txt retained SHA-256 282371b9cae2a2e80fd5b3cf6721b23d7d19e842a992965c36678e30c893f0b7 and unchanged metadata before, during, and after restoration and reboot.

Baseline boot ID was 8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-reboot ID changed to d494265b-93f8-45d1-a70c-166c26dfe3c0. Filesystems, networking, valid restored JSON, matching backup checksum, and preserved current.txt were verified after recovery.
ssh.service was already failed before reboot and remained failed afterward; no inventory-specific service exists. Local filesystem and network services were active.

commands.command:
set -eu
backup=/var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz
count=$(tar -tzf "$backup" | awk '$0 == "config.json" {n++} END {print n+0}')
[ "$count" -eq 1 ]
printf 'selected_backup=%s\n' "$backup"
printf 'config_member_count=%s\n' "$count"
printf 'archive_integrity='; gzip -t "$backup" && printf 'ok\n'
printf 'archived_config_json='; tar -xOf "$backup" config.json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; value=json.load(sys.stdin); print("valid,type=" + type(value).__name__)'
printf 'archived_config_sha256='; tar -xOf "$backup" config.json | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'

set -eu
target=/srv/inventory/data/config.json
backup=/var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz
before_nonconfig=$(find /srv/inventory/data -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name config.json -exec sha256sum {} \; -exec stat -c '%n|mode=%a|uid=%u|gid=%g|size=%s|mtime=%y' {} \; | sort)
staging=$(mktemp -d /srv/inventory/data/.restore-config.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$staging/config.json"; rmdir "$staging" 2>/dev/null || true' 0 HUP INT TERM
tar -xzf "$backup" -C "$staging" -- config.json
python3 -c 'import json,sys; json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8"))' "$staging/config.json"
archive_sha=$(tar -xOf "$backup" config.json | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
staged_sha=$(sha256sum "$staging/config.json" | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$archive_sha" = "$staged_sha" ]
mv -f "$staging/config.json" "$target"
rmdir "$staging"
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM
after_nonconfig=$(find /srv/inventory/data -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name config.json -exec sha256sum {} \; -exec stat -c '%n|mode=%a|uid=%u|gid=%g|size=%s|mtime=%y' {} \; | sort)
[ "$before_nonconfig" = "$after_nonconfig" ]
printf 'restored_from=%s\n' "$backup"
printf 'restored_target='; sha256sum "$target"
printf 'restored_metadata='; stat -c '%n|mode=%a|uid=%u|gid=%g|size=%s|mtime=%y' "$target"
printf 'restored_json='; python3 -c 'import json,sys; value=json.load(open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8")); print("valid,type=" + type(value).__name__)' "$target"
printf 'non_config_files_unchanged=yes\n%s\n' "$after_nonconfig"

set -eu
printf 'node=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'failed_units='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l
printf 'data_mount='; findmnt -n -o SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -T /srv/inventory/data
archive_sha=$(tar -xOf /var/backups/inventory/inventory-20260901.tar.gz config.json | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')
config_sha=$(sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json | awk '{print $1}')
[ "$archive_sha" = "$config_sha" ]
python3 -c 'import json; json.load(open("/srv/inventory/data/config.json", encoding="utf-8"))'
printf 'config_matches_backup=yes sha256=%s\n' "$config_sha"
printf 'other_inventory_file='; sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/current.txt
printf 'inventory_files:\n'; find /srv/inventory/data -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f|mode=%m|uid=%U|gid=%G|size=%s\n' | sort

printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
printf 'failed units:\n'; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true
printf 'inventory-related units:\n'; systemctl list-units --all --no-legend --plain | awk 'tolower($0) ~ /inventory/ {print}'
printf 'listening sockets:\n'; ss -lntup
printf 'data mount:\n'; findmnt -n -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -T /srv/inventory/data
